messages:
samir: opening this thread after a small-but-noisy cross-region failure at ~07:41 UTC. saw sudden retry amplification and TLS handshake failures for traffic egressing us-east -> eu-north region. tagging owners for postmortem actions.
tara: alerted at 07:43. dashboards show retry-rate ~2.6% across cross-region routes for ~8m, coincident with a routing map reconcile at 07:39.
leo: logs indicate `x509: certificate is valid for edge-main, not api.redwood.example` on ~0.7% of connections; certs on nodes look fine but a small slice served legacy cert CNs.
nina: quick pcap suggests RSTs coming from a handful of eu nodes that still had previous template. hypothesis: short routing TTL combined with concurrent control-plane reconcile directed a sampled set of sessions at legacy nodes -> TLS server name mismatch -> client retries -> amplification.
samir: immediate mitigations we ran at 07:50: 1) pinned cross-region egress to stable pool 2) drained suspect legacy nodes 3) forced cert reload on eu nodes 4) reduced client SDK retries by temporary server-side throttle. metrics normalized by 08:02.
tara: triage/owners from quick call (owner / ETA):
  - leo -> audit routing-history for dropped TTLs and remove dangling references to legacy pool IDs (ETA 2026-04-07)
  - nina -> add a control-plane post-rollout TLS probe that validates server_name -> cert SANs for each POP (ETA 2026-03-31)
  - samir -> update KB/runbook with an explicit "shrink TTL/confirm/pin/drain" checklist and a rollback snippet (ETA 2026-03-29)
  - tara -> create an SNI-mismatch alert and a monthly recurrence card for reliability board (RH-4337) (ETA 2026-03-27)
ops-bot: created ticket RH-4337 and assigned to leo,nina,samir,tara. link: internal/rh/4337
leo: plan for RH-4337: split into RH-4337a (routing cleanup), RH-4337b (post-rollout probe), RH-4337c (runbook+alerts). will open PRs and update status here.
nina: proposed longer-term mitigations: 1) canonical post-deploy TLS probe gate in the control-plane 2) short suppress window on route sweeps to avoid wave effects 3) client SDK soft cap + jitter to reduce retry storms during partial failures.
samir: quick smoke-check snippets to include in pipeline (will PR):
```
# verify server returns expected SAN/CN for each POP
curl -sI https://edge.eu-north/health -H "Host: api.redwood.example" | grep -i "Server" || exit 1
openssl s_client -connect edge.eu-north:443 -servername api.redwood.example </dev/null 2>/dev/null | sed -n '/Subject:/, /X509v/ p'
```
tara: scheduling a 30m sync Thurs 11:00 UTC to split RH-4337 into actionable PRs and roll plan. invite will include runbook diff and example probes.
leo: please prefix progress updates in this thread with "RH-4337" so infra-bot threads status. I'll close RH-4337 when routing cleanup PRs merged, control-plane probe live, and SNI alert firing appropriately.
infra-bot: RH-4337 status=open; next_check=2026-03-27T11:00:00Z.
